name: LURE
source:
You are a new fisherman in town who got tired of the life in the city. You decide to move to a remote coastal village in search of peace and a calm life. It all seems perfect, but it doesn’t take long to realize that beneath the calm surface of the sea lurks something unsettling that will change your life. Will you be able to save the town? Or will you get swallowed by the depths? There is only one way to find out.
